name: Staged ownership transfer path
description: Ownership transfers to employees in stages over time. Structured per Employee Ownership Journey v0.2's staged-transfer path; seeded values are starting points to confirm or replace.

seed_assumptions.name: Transfer happens in stages
seed_assumptions.description: The number of stages the owner's working assumption contemplates before the employees hold the business fully.

seed_assumptions.name: Shares sold per stage are roughly equal
seed_assumptions.description: The working assumption that each stage transfers a similar block of ownership.

seed_assumptions.name: Owner needs stage proceeds to be predictable
seed_assumptions.description: The owner's working assumption about how much the timing of stage payments matters to their own plans.

seed_unknowns.description: The tax consequences of selling in stages rather than all at once are not understood yet.
seed_unknowns.required_action: Ask a tax professional to compare staged versus single-sale treatment before committing to stages.

seed_unknowns.description: Which employees would buy in the early stages — and whether later-stage buyers exist — is unknown.
